Requirements for staff rotas

Purpose: to keep Companion Animal Travel Desk coverage steady, kind, and ready to support travelers and their animals through each stage of service.

Staff rotas must be built so that the desk always has enough trained people to answer queries, check travel arrangements, and support welfare needs without leaving the counter exposed. The planner should balance peak demand, irregular arrivals, and follow-up work, while leaving room for breaks and handover notes. When a service change affects a traveler with an animal, the desk records the update in the ledger and passes the detail to the welfare coordinator and the ground team without delay.

The rota should include at least one member who can speak calmly to anxious travelers and one member who can guide baggage and crate handling. If a traveler arrives with a concern about crate condition, feeding, or comfort, staff should respond with steady reassurance, confirm the next step, and keep the discussion focused on service needs. <<FACT F118>> If a case involves a delayed departure, the desk logs the report, issues the required support route, and keeps the traveler informed in plain language. <<FACT F109>>

Staff must also protect continuity during shift changes. Each handover should note pending checks, animal welfare observations, and any special handling instructions so the next person can act without repeating the same questions. The ground team must move carriers carefully between services, avoid unnecessary handling, and report any change in condition at once. The welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs and may request extra water, rest, or quiet space when that will improve the animal's well-being.

The desk welcomes questions in a warm professional tone and keeps records clear, complete, and easy to trace. When rota pressures rise, the senior coordinator should reassign support before service quality drops, rather than waiting for a problem to grow. If there is any doubt about coverage, animal handling, or claim routing, contact the operations lead for guidance.
